intro.title: Introduction
intro.content: PickNKick ("the App") is a web application for organizing soccer team drafts. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.

dataCollected.title: Information We Collect
dataCollected.content: When you use PickNKick, we may collect the following information:
items: Email address (when signing up or logging in with Google)
Name and profile photo (from your Google account, if you sign in with Google)
Player names you add to your club roster

usage.title: How We Use Your Information
items: Provide the draft and team management service
Identify you when you log back in
usage.noSelling: We do not sell your information to third parties.

storage.title: Data Storage
storage.content: Your information is stored securely on Supabase servers. We use encryption and secure authentication to protect your data.

googleOAuth.title: Google OAuth
googleOAuth.content: When you sign in with Google, we receive access to your name, email address, and profile photo only. We do not access your contacts, emails, or any other information in your Google account.

deletion.title: Data Deletion
deletion.content: You can request deletion of your data at any time by contacting us. You can also disconnect your Google account from your Google account settings.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By using PickNKick, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please stop using the service.

description.title: The Service
description.content: PickNKick provides a platform for organizing team drafts for recreational soccer. The service enables:
items: Creating live drafts for team selection

accounts.title: User Accounts
accounts.content: Some features require creating an account. You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account. Quick draft does not require an account.

conduct.title: Acceptable Use
conduct.content: The service is intended for personal use to organize recreational soccer games. Do not use the service for illegal or harmful activities.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.content: The service is provided "as is." We do our best to provide reliable service, but we do not guarantee 100% availability or specific outcomes.

changes.title: Changes to Terms
changes.content: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of the service after an update constitutes acceptance of the new terms.
